correctness.rationale: The source DADL mass function is Cτ(1+t)exp(-θt) with t=τj for j>=0 and t=k/τ for negative label -k. Merging the two locally finite positive lattices into sites 0=s0<s1<... reduces global mode selection to maximizing strictly concave log(1+t)-θt. Consecutive secant slopes β_i strictly decrease from positive β0 to zero: θ∈(β_i,β_{i-1}) uniquely maximizes site s_i; θ=β_i ties only consecutive sites. Coincident positive/negative labels arise iff τ²=a/b rational, with exact positive/negative lattice support a|m,b|m. Both sign-only sites recur unbounded iff a,b>1 or τ² irrational; therefore infinitely many reversals of unique modal sign near θ=0 exactly when neither τ² nor its reciprocal is a positive integer. Independent direct-PMF finite scans checked six τ regimes including 1,2,1/2,sqrt(3/2),sqrt(2),sqrt(pi), and interior modes and threshold numerics matched; strict concavity and divisibility prove the infinite assertion.
residual_risks: Finite validation is not a proof for unbounded parameter ranges.
